item.title: This Day in New Jersey History — November 10: Queen's College charter is signed in New Brunswick
item.description: On November 10, 1766, the charter for Queen's College, later Rutgers University, was signed in New Brunswick by Royal Governor William Franklin. Source: Rutgers University historical research
